text: Install Prefect in a uv venv, run a hello flow against the local model endpoint at 127.0.0.1:8771, then try the Kestra Docker quickstart

check: unset PYTHONHOME and PYTHONPATH (env -u PYTHONHOME -u PYTHONPATH) before starting any Python other than the Aside runtime's own
prepend ~/.local/bin and /usr/local/bin to PATH (or call the absolute path) and run command -v before reporting a tool missing

run docker info and require a server version before any Docker-route step; a missing daemon is recorded BLOCKED with the command and its error, and colima start runs from an Orca terminal, not the sandbox

run env_probe.py and read jdks: the macOS java stub fails without a registered JDK while keg-only Homebrew JDKs work through JAVA_HOME; pick one at or above the framework's required version (Kestra needs 25), else use Docker, and record the JVM route BLOCKED only when no JDK qualifies

assert non-empty message content and finish_reason stop on every hello completion; disable thinking (chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false) or budget max_tokens, because a reasoning model returns HTTP 200 with empty content when reasoning eats the token budget

probe every model route with GET /v1/models and one real completion at run start; memory, config and yesterday's probe are not liveness, and a LAN address that fails from the sandbox is recorded UNREACHABLE_FROM_SANDBOX, not down
fetch the framework's official install or quickstart page today, record its URL and text sha256, and pin the version you install; install commands are never written from memory

run env_probe.py and read library_validation before choosing a Python route; when it is PRESENT or LIKELY, send native-extension dependencies to a pure-Python fallback, a version pin, a stub, or the host shell (Orca terminal), record which one, and never strip quarantine attributes without Mike's approval

run env_probe.py and read listeners_on_framework_ports before starting a framework server; a bound port is a stray to report with pid, command, and bind address (all-interface binds flagged for Mike), never a server you own, and your own server starts on a fresh loopback port under a time-box
